title.narrative: Department of Energy, International Nuclear Security Capacity Building Activities

description.narrative: The U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration (DOE/NNSA) Office of International Nuclear Security (INS) works to lead and partner in U.S. international efforts to prevent threat and sabotage of nuclear materials and facilities worldwide by strengthening global nuclear security norms through White House initiatives on cybersecurity, insider threat mitigation, and transport security.
